briefings.title: Going In Deep On Data | YC Paper Club
briefings.tldr: Data quality, expert supervision, and data mixing have overtaken model architecture as the primary bottlenecks in AI development, generating over $100 billion in market capitalization and enabling new paradigms in real-time diffusion models and multilingual pre-training.

briefings.title: Multi-GPU Kernels, Intelligence per Watt, Heterogeneous Inference, and More | YC Paper Club
briefings.tldr: As data center compute and specialized hardware scaling accelerate, builders are unlocking massive efficiency gains by specializing at the chip, kernel, and inference infrastructure levels—transitioning from monolithic workloads toward heterogeneous local AI, parallelized multi-GPU execution, and GPU-accelerated simulation.

briefings.title: Beyond Bigger Models: Recursion As The Next Scaling Law In AI
briefings.tldr: Recursive AI models like Hierarchical Reasoning Models (HRM) and Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) achieve state-of-the-art reasoning performance—outperforming models 1,000x their size on tasks like the ARC Prize—by utilizing weight reuse and latent memory states at inference time to bypass the "reasoning ceiling" of standard feed-forward LLMs.
